metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: ASIM Email Event filtering parser for Proofpoint POD messages
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string='*',
    disabled:bool=false,
    pack:bool=false) {
  ProofpointPODMessage_CL
  | where not(disabled)
  | where isnull(starttime) or eventTime >= starttime
  | where isnull(endtime) or eventTime <= endtime
  | where eventresult == '*' or eventresult == 'NA'
  | where array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0
  | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
      or has_any_ipv4_prefix(tostring(connection.ip), ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
  | extend
      EmailFromAddress=iff(array_length(msg.parsedAddresses.from) == 1, tostring(msg.parsedAddresses.from[0]), ""),
      EmailToRecipients=iff(isnull(msg.parsedAddresses['to']), dynamic([]), msg.parsedAddresses['to']),
      EmailSubject=iff(array_length(msg.normalizedHeader.subject) == 1, tostring(msg.normalizedHeader.subject[0]), ""),
      EmailDirection=case(
          ['filter'].routeDirection =~ "inbound", "Inbound",
          ['filter'].routeDirection =~ "outbound", "Outbound",
          ['filter'].routeDirection =~ "internal", "Internal",
          ['filter'].routeDirection =~ "local", "Local",
          "Unknown")
  | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0 or EmailFromAddress has_any (emailfromaddress_has_any)
  | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0 or EmailToRecipients has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
  | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0 or EmailSubject has_any (emailsubject_has_any)
  | where array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or EmailDirection in~ (emaildirection_in)
  | project-rename EventStartTime=eventTime, EventOriginalUid=guid
  | extend
      EventVendor="Proofpoint",
      EventProduct="POD",
      EventSchema="EmailEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion="1.0.0",
      EventType="EmailInspection",
      EventCount=int(1),
      EventEndTime=EventStartTime,
      EventResult="NA",
      EventProductVersion=coalesce(tostring(pps.version), tostring(metadata.origin.data.version)),
      DvcFQDN=coalesce(tostring(pps.agent), tostring(metadata.origin.data.agent)),
      DvcOriginalAction=tostring(['filter'].disposition),
      SrcIpAddr=tostring(connection.ip),
      SrcFQDN=tostring(connection.host),
      SrcGeoCountry=tostring(connection.country),
      Dst=iff(array_length(envelope.rcpts) == 1, tostring(envelope.rcpts[0]), tostring(envelope.rcpts)),
      EmailMailFromAddress=tostring(envelope.from),
      EmailSizeBytes=tolong(msg.sizeBytes),
      EmailLanguage=tostring(msg.lang),
      EmailProtocolName=iff(tostring(connection.protocol) =~ "smtp:smtp", "SMTP", ""),
      EmailSpfOriginalResult=tostring(['filter'].modules.spf.result),
      EmailDmarcOriginalResult=tostring(['filter'].modules.dmarc.filterdResult),
      EmailDkimOriginalResult=iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) == 1, tostring(['filter'].modules.dkimv[0].result), ""),
      EmailDkimDomain=iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) == 1, tostring(['filter'].modules.dkimv[0].domain), ""),
      DvcEntityKey="",
      AdditionalEntities=dynamic([]),
      AdditionalFields=iff(pack, bag_pack(
          "connection", connection, "envelope", envelope, "msg", msg,
          "pps", pps, "metadata", metadata, "filter", ['filter'], "msgParts", msgParts), dynamic({})),
      Type=tostring(column_ifexists("Type", "ProofpointPODMessage_CL"))
  | extend
      Dvc=coalesce(DvcFQDN, EventProduct),
      DvcHostname=tostring(split(DvcFQDN, ".")[0]),
      DvcDomain=iff(indexof(DvcFQDN, ".") >= 0, substring(DvcFQDN, indexof(DvcFQDN, ".") + 1), ""),
      DvcAction=iff(DvcOriginalAction in~ ("reject", "discard"), "Blocked", "NA"),
      Src=coalesce(SrcIpAddr, SrcFQDN),
      SrcHostname=tostring(split(SrcFQDN, ".")[0]),
      SrcDomain=iff(indexof(SrcFQDN, ".") >= 0, substring(SrcFQDN, indexof(SrcFQDN, ".") + 1), ""),
      EmailMailFromDomain=tostring(split(EmailMailFromAddress, "@")[1]),
      EmailFromDomain=tostring(split(EmailFromAddress, "@")[1]),
      EmailSpfResult=case(
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "pass", "Pass",
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "fail", "Fail",
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "softfail", "SoftFail",
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "neutral", "Neutral",
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "none", "None",
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "temperror", "TemporaryError",
          EmailSpfOriginalResult =~ "permerror", "PermanentError", ""),
      EmailDmarcResult=case(
          EmailDmarcOriginalResult =~ "pass", "Pass",
          EmailDmarcOriginalResult =~ "fail", "Fail",
          EmailDmarcOriginalResult =~ "none", "None", ""),
      EmailDkimResult=case(
          EmailDkimOriginalResult =~ "pass", "Pass",
          EmailDkimOriginalResult =~ "fail", "Fail",
          EmailDkimOriginalResult =~ "none", "None",
          EmailDkimOriginalResult =~ "temperror", "TemporaryError",
          EmailDkimOriginalResult =~ "permerror", "PermanentError", "")
  | extend
      DvcDomainType=iff(isnotempty(DvcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
      SrcDomainType=iff(isnotempty(SrcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
      IpAddr=SrcIpAddr
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type,
      EventVendor, EventProduct, EventProductVersion, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
      EventType, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventResult, EventOriginalUid,
      Dvc, DvcFQDN, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcOriginalAction, DvcAction, DvcEntityKey,
      Src, SrcIpAddr, SrcFQDN, SrcHostname, SrcDomain, SrcDomainType, SrcGeoCountry, IpAddr, Dst,
      EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain, EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain,
      EmailToRecipients, EmailSubject, EmailSizeBytes, EmailLanguage, EmailDirection, EmailProtocolName,
      EmailSpfOriginalResult, EmailSpfResult, EmailDmarcOriginalResult, EmailDmarcResult,
      EmailDkimOriginalResult, EmailDkimResult, EmailDkimDomain,
      AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any,
    emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in,
    emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
